incidents.name: Reaper Farm vault missing access control on deposit-for
incidents.notes: The Reaper vault exposed a deposit path that took the source address as a parameter with no check that it was the caller, so anyone could pull tokens from every wallet that had approved the vault.

sources.ref: onchain review on Fantom over a public RPC: the PoC carries no transaction hash, so the exploit tx was recovered by querying eth_getLogs on the vault 0xcdA5deA176F2dF95082f4daDb96255Bdb2bc7C7D across the PoC's fork block window (44045897-44045905), which yields 0xc929f3b9...c9d5 at block 44045900 with ten logs. Creation resolved by binary search over eth_getCode to block 41839240, 2022-07-02T12:48:36Z, creator 0x6539519e69343535a2af6583d9bae3ad74c6a293, not the attack-tx sender 0x5636e55e4a72299a0f194c001841e2ce75bb527a; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, 30.7 days old. Loss ~1.7M US$ across multiple ERC-20s per the DeFiHackLabs 2022 index entry for this PoC.
